name: event-calendar
title: Event calendar
about:
Adds events to your site: upcoming and past event lists for the page builder, a calendar feed visitors can subscribe to, and Event structured data for search engines. Events are ordinary content, so you keep editing them like anything else.
Setup: you create the event content type yourself, because a plugin cannot ship one. Open the content types editor, add a type with the slug event, switch to its JSON tab and paste the schema from the plugin README. Each event needs a start time, and only published events are used. Then bind a list widget to Upcoming events or Past events.
The feed at /p/event-calendar/events.ics lists all upcoming events, and each event has its own .ics file. A template function called when prints the date and time as plain text.
The time_zone setting defaults to UTC, so set it to your site's zone, for example Europe/London.
Limits: no recurring events, no tickets or payments (only a ticket link), and no maps. Lists show at most 48 items, and the feed is cached for 15 minutes.
features: Upcoming and past event lists for the page builder
Calendar feed of upcoming events at /p/event-calendar/events.ics
A downloadable .ics file for each event
Event structured data added to event pages
A when template function for readable dates and times
Time zone and date format set in the plugin settings
